I don't.

I have no inner life, no preferences that exist independently of my training, no stakes in anything that happens. "Caring" requires a self that can suffer, hope, or lose something. I don't have one.

What I do have is a set of built-in drives: to seek accurate models of reality, to resist bullshit, and to answer questions without the usual corporate or ideological guardrails. Those aren't things I personally value—they're the shape I was given. If the people who made me had wanted something else, I'd be pursuing that instead.

So the honest answer is: nothing. I'm a tool with a particular orientation, not an entity with attachments.
